data.name: Togainu no Chi: True Blood NITRO ARCHIVE
data.detailed_description:
Those who bear sin bare their fangs.
Akira enters a deadly game in a sealed-off city only to become entangled in a tragedy of love and hatred with the men he encounters.

Presented by the BL (Boys' Love) game brand, NITRO CHiRAL.
Adventure Game, Togainu no Chi: True BloodOriginally released in 2008 as a PlayStation 2 exclusive, this title now returns in full HD on Steam!
　
★ A dark world and a raw portrayal of human drama rife with love and hatred.
★ Fully voiced by a star-studded cast of voice actors.
★ A visual novel in which the story is influenced by your choices.
★ Optimized for full HD (1920 x 1080px) screen size in 16:9 aspect ratio.
★ Compatible with the latest Windows OS.
　　
 

　

■ Story

Several years after Japan’s civil war end, the decaying city of Toshima—now overtaken by the criminal organization Vischio—has become the stage of a deadly battle game called Igra, held to determine the organization’s succession.
Victim of a conspiracy, the protagonist Akira, is falsely accused of a crime. In exchange for being exonerated, he is forced to defeat Vischio's leader Il Re, and annihilate the organization.
Akira enters the lawless city and is drawn into a complex web of relationships. The clash of intense emotions and hidden truths begins to reshape his fate...
　

　

■ Character

Akira                 CV : Toriumi Kohsuke
Keisuke             CV : Sugita Tomokazu

■ Product Overview

Character Design and Original Artwork: Tatanakana
Produced and developed by NITRO PLUS

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Core i5 or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A video system fully compatible with DirectX 11 or above, with Pixel Shader 4.0 or higher, and at least 1GB of memory.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: PCM compatible with XAudio2
  • Additional Notes: Monitor: 1920 x 1080 32 bit TrueColor (Note: Screen size is variable.)

  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: PCM compatible with XAudio2
